name: SGLang and Baseten: about 2,500 tokens/sec at batch size 1 for DeepSeek v4.1 Flash on Vera Rubin, up to 1.7x GB300
title: SGLang and Baseten: about 2,500 tokens/sec at batch size 1 for DeepSeek v4.1 Flash on Vera Rubin, up to 1.7x GB300
summary: SGLang shares Baseten's test numbers from the SGLang Summit: roughly 2,500 tokens per second at batch size 1 for DeepSeek v4.1 Flash on Vera Rubin, up to 1.7 times faster than GB300. They say the low-latency optimizations are being brought to open source.
